==Using fairy rings==
[[File:Fairy rings selection.png|thumb|300px|The fairy ring code selection screen.]]
To use the fairy rings, players must complete the following quests:
*[[The Restless Ghost]]
*[[Priest in Peril]]
*[[Nature Spirit]]
*[[Lost City]]
*[[Fairytale I - Growing Pains]]
*Partially completed [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]] (up until you're "granted permission" to use them)
Players can quickly access the fairy ring network with any of the following teleports:
